scripts.db:status:production: node scripts/require-env-file.mjs .env.production && dotenv -e .env.production -- prisma migrate status
scripts.db:migrate:production: node scripts/require-env-file.mjs .env.production && dotenv -e .env.production -- prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:status:preview: node scripts/require-env-file.mjs .env.preview && dotenv -e .env.preview -- prisma migrate status
scripts.db:migrate:preview: node scripts/require-env-file.mjs .env.preview && dotenv -e .env.preview -- prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:seed:preview: node scripts/require-env-file.mjs .env.preview && dotenv -e .env.preview -e supabase/seed/.env.test-accounts -- node scripts/seed/seed.mjs
scripts.db:reset:preview: node scripts/require-env-file.mjs .env.preview && dotenv -e .env.preview -- node scripts/seed/wipe.mjs && npm run db:migrate:preview && npm run db:seed:preview
